Every integer C not congruent 2 mod4 has an explicit difference-of-squares point whose vertical residue survives every fixed QR wheel, so a fixed residue table cannot delete an admissible strip entirely.

methods.name: Exact quotient-root atlas and ternary state-count carry operator
capabilities: compute the exact state-specific coalescence horizon and high-denominator cutoff

methods.core_law: For n>=1 and r>=1, with H=R_(r+1)(r*n-1) and D=floor(n/(H+1)^r), the quotient-root atlas R_r(floor(n/d)), 1<=d<=n, is the disjoint union of an injective D-state high chart and the forced low interval 1..H-1 plus at most the horizon H. Hence |S|+1=D+H+kappa; with q=floor(H/r) the three-point D-band compresses this to |S|+1=H+q+tau with tau in {0,1,2} selected by two exact thresholds.
methods.hard_boundary: DOMAIN_OPERATOR only. The carrier is the finite positive-denominator quotient-root atlas. Do not generalize to arbitrary floor maps or quotient semigroups, do not infer prime/factoring/Legendre or continuum claims, do not erase the H=0 branch, and do not treat the ternary state-count carry as a universal T5 carry law. No Foundation mutation follows.

methods.name: BRC error linearization / Pell-Pade tail transport
capabilities: exact affine post-truncation derivative ratio (1+x)E^(n+1)/E^n=1/2-n

methods.core_law: For E_K=sqrt(1+x)-1-P_K, derivatives above order K satisfy (1+x)E_K^(n+1)/E_K^n=1/2-n, while ordinary BRC correction gaps satisfy G_q=G_0-q(2a+q). The diagonal Pade/Pell approximant obtained from (1+sqrt(1+x))^(2n+1)=P_n+sqrt(1+x)Q_n yields homogenized integers A_n,B_n with (m+h)B_n^2-mA_n^2=h^(2n+1). This makes A_n/B_n a rigorous lower sqrt-ratio predictor and gives the exact sufficient certificate J h^(2n+1)<=m A_n B_n for at most two BRC basin corrections.
methods.hard_boundary: Classical Pade/Pell approximation is prior art. The current contribution is exact BRC composition, certification, and error-linearization bookkeeping. The Python reference path is substantially faster than the previous high-order Taylor table-free tail but still slower than direct optimized isqrt on isolated steps. No asymptotic factorization speedup, RSA-practicality, optimal multiplier order, or Foundation promotion is claimed.

methods.name: BRC multiplier square-content scan reduction
capabilities: exact one-shot stripping of every multiplier square factor whose root divides the known BRC ceiling root
exact immediate-ceiling witness preservation under m->m/g^2 and x->x/g
same gcd-factor preservation under declared gcd(n,m)=1

methods.core_law: Write m=a^2 d with d squarefree and x=ceil(sqrt(mn)). Under gcd(n,m)=1, g=gcd(a,x) divides the square root y of every successful completion gap y^2=x^2-mn. Dividing m,x,y by g^2,g,g yields the exact immediate ceiling witness at m/g^2, and gcd(x-y,n)=gcd(x/g-y/g,n). After this one-shot normalization gcd(a/g,x/g)=1, so all square content visible in the current ceiling root has been removed.
methods.hard_boundary: Requires an already-known exact ceiling root and declared gcd(n,m)=1; a nontrivial multiplier gcd should be handled as a factor witness before this reduction. Squareful multipliers are not statically discardable: states with gcd(square-content-root,ceiling-root)=1 can be genuine first hits. Common-factor scaling is elementary prior art; no novelty priority, asymptotic factorization speedup, or Foundation promotion is claimed.

methods.core_law: With gamma_m=sqrt((m+1)/m)-1, choose B so J_m<2^(B-1), C_m=floor(2^B gamma_m), d0=floor(C_m J_m/2^B). Then J_(m+1)-(J_m+d0) is in {0,1,2}. The provisional remainder is R_m+N-d0(2J_m+d0); subtracting successive odd basin widths at most twice yields exactly R_(m+1).

methods.core_law: For fixed m,N and x_0=ceil(sqrt(mN)), D_t=(x_0+t)^2-mN is periodic modulo M as a function of t mod M. Therefore every exact square hit lies in W_M={r:(x_0+r)^2-mN is a quadratic residue mod M}. Enumerating only translated copies of W_M is observer-safe for squarehood rejection; exact D_t can be reconstructed as D_0+t(2x_0+t) only after surviving all declared modular observers.

The adaptive 1008/20160 wheel threshold is a finite Python benchmark policy, not a theorem. Timing gains inside a fixed search rectangle do not reduce the classical rectangle size or imply an asymptotic factoring improvement. No Foundation promotion is made.

methods.name: BRC local neighbor-square lift fixed-gap shortcut
triggers: large v2 of N plus or minus a small distance
known square divisor of N plus or minus d
capabilities: derive m=2a-epsilon*d from any known a^2 dividing N-epsilon*d
reduce the multiplier-Fermat test to squarehood of mt+1 with fixed gap root abs(a-epsilon*d)
discover the unique signed distance in certain bounded power-of-two neighborhoods using one low-bit mask rather than scanning d
prove that absence of the unique start-level distance prevents every higher power-of-two level from reviving a candidate in the same distance window
enumerate all beyond-horizon power-of-two levels on the unique neighbor when all_levels is requested
probe only multipliers beyond an existing bounded horizon
reuse the exact BALANCED quadratic-residue cascade before isqrt
recover a proper factor by gcd when the exact square witness splits N
return immediately to the ordinary exact fallback on a miss
methods.core_law: If N=a^2 t+epsilon*d with epsilon in {+1,-1} and m=2a-epsilon*d, then mN=a^2(mt+1)-(a-epsilon*d)^2. Therefore mt+1=c^2 gives mN=(ac)^2-(a-epsilon*d)^2. For a0=2^k satisfying 2(a0/2)+D<=H<2a0+D and 2D<a0^2, every beyond-H power-of-two candidate with |d|<=D shares the unique signed residue d determined by N mod a0^2. If that residue lies outside D, no higher power-of-two level can revive a candidate. For H=100,D=64 the exact start level is a0=32, so the full radius-64 distance search reduces to one N mod1024 low-bit observation plus at most one v2 chain.
methods.hard_boundary: This remains a specialization of classical multiplier-Fermat/difference-of-squares inside T0_BRC. The local-window compression removes distance-scan overhead but does not increase the mathematical density of square hits. The committed balanced diagnostic has one horizon-extending hit in the 1009..4999-prime cohort and no hits in the larger 10007..50000 or random-24-bit-prime cohorts at H=100,D=64. It must not replace a complete scan, must not trigger open-ended distance/horizon expansion after a miss, and establishes no asymptotic factorization improvement.
